suppress.notes: CVE-2025-10492: Java deserialisation of externally supplied data in the JasperReports library. The application compiles templates from its own classpath (src/main/resources/reports, guarded by ReportTemplateHygieneTest) and fills them from Java beans; no serialised report, template or data ever comes from a client. The fix is JasperReports 7.0.3+, a major upgrade tracked as its own item. Reviewed 7 Sep 2026.

CVE-2025-7962: SMTP injection in Jakarta Mail before 2.0.2. Matched by CPE against angus-activation, which is not Jakarta Mail; the mail library on the classpath is org.eclipse.angus:jakarta.mail 2.0.5, past the fix. Reviewed 7 Sep 2026.

Spring Framework 6.2.19 advisories with no released fix on 7 Sep 2026 (the advisories name 6.2.20, which is not on Maven Central; Boot 3.5.16 is the latest 3.5 release). Assessed against this application, a servlet-stack Spring MVC API: CVE-2026-47891, -47892, -47893 are WebFlux-only (Aalto XML, functional endpoints, WebSocket), and WebFlux is not on the classpath; CVE-2026-47890 and -59313 are SSE stream corruption with view fragments or the functional web framework, neither used (the one SseEmitter, the alert stream, is a plain controller); CVE-2026-59283 needs the SpEL compiler on a SimpleEvaluationContext, which the application does not use; CVE-2026-59282 is a denial of service through user-supplied property paths in data binding, bounded here by the API rate limit and the request size limits, and the only one of the set that could reach this code. Re-check for Spring 6.2.20 / Boot 3.5.17 by the review date. Reviewed 7 Sep 2026.

Spring Security 6.5.11 advisories with no released fix on 7 Sep 2026 (6.5.12 is not on Maven Central). CVE-2026-59270 is the embedded UnboundID LDAP test server, which the application neither depends on nor starts; CVE-2026-47841 is WebAuthn user verification with a distributed session store, and the application uses neither WebAuthn nor a distributed session (stateless JWT). Re-check by the review date. Reviewed 7 Sep 2026.

CVE-2026-65898: DOMPurify 3.3.2 inside the swagger-ui webjar (allowlist mutation through a hook the page itself would have to register). Swagger UI is served only under the dev profile (DevActuatorSwaggerSecurityConfig) and springdoc 2.8.17 is the latest release of the 2.8 line that pairs with Boot 3.5. CVSS 5.1, below the gate; listed so the report stays readable. Reviewed 7 Sep 2026.
